examples.title: Situations you might recognize
examples.lead: AssetFlow won't diagnose a fault, guarantee coverage, or promise savings — but it keeps the records, dates, and next steps together so you can act on them.

item1.quote: “I just bought a used car. What service is due, and when does the insurance renew?”
item1.help: Add the car once, attach the documents you have, and confirm the suggested service and renewal dates so they show up when they matter.

item2.quote: “The appliance is making a noise. Can I find the receipt and warranty?”
item2.help: Keep receipts, manuals, and warranty details linked to the appliance, so you're not searching through drawers or old emails.

item3.quote: “Did we already book the boiler service — or was that last year?”
item3.help: A shared history of completed work means the household can check what was actually done, and when, instead of relying on memory.

item4.quote: “The bike needs attention, but I can't remember its last service.”
item4.help: Log completed work as you go, so the next suggested task always starts from an accurate history.

item5.quote: “Should I repair this device or replace it? What have I already spent?”
item5.help: Review recorded costs and history together as a starting point for the decision — the choice, and the outcome, stay yours.

step1.title: Add an asset
step1.body: Register what you own — a car, appliance, tool, or anything else you look after.

step2.title: Keep its documents and details together
step2.body: Attach receipts, manuals, warranties, and insurance so they live with the asset.

step3.title: Review suggested tasks and dates, then confirm
step3.body: Suggestions are drafts you review and approve — nothing is added automatically.

step4.title: Log completed work and use the history
step4.body: Recorded work becomes the history you rely on for the next decision.

categories.title: What you can organize
categories.note: Warranties, insurance policies, and service contracts are linked records with their own dates — not physical assets by themselves.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: All plans are billed in EUR. Plans differ by active asset allowance, shared AI credits, and additional collaborators.

plus.name: Plus
plus.tagline: More room and a bit of collaboration.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: More capacity for a growing household.

pricing.note: Active assets are concurrently tracked assets; archived assets don't count toward the limit. AI credits are shared across chat, maintenance suggestions, and decisions, and don't roll over month to month.

closing.title: Ready to get a handle on what you own?
